order: context then route; warmup original/candidate once; rounds alternate original/candidate and reverse on odd round
boundary: captured owned complete call plus all-output consumer; CPU arena upload/execution/unpack inclusive spans; GPU total includes transfer/dispatch/readback, no isolated shader timing
limits: Instrumented spans perturb execution and do not estimate uninstrumented speed.
One checked U32 recipe with four sizes and two value regimes; other carriers retain existing small reference fixtures only.
Synthetic saved profile forces auto JS without online probes; no calibrated profitability claim.
Same compiled bundle bytes isolate hosts; this is not compiler or backend comparison.
GPU asynchronous work is included in return interval; no hardware timestamp queries.
F32, u64, scalar legacy, strings and nested carriers are covered by parity separately, outside this attribution matrix.
